facts.text: The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet: a large cinematic hero image at the top, a row of three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and a row of four detail crops at the bottom.

In the top hero panel, a person stands on wet, reflective pavement at night as rain falls, with metal railings on both sides, city lights in the distance, and an illuminated building facade to the right.
The person wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with a chest strap and buckle, a dark shirt, black cargo pants, and black lace-up combat boots.
The person has short dark hair that is shaved at the sides, with longer hair gathered into a small topknot or bun at the back.
The middle row contains three full-body studio views against a dark gray backdrop, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK; the figure stands with arms at the sides in each.
The bottom row contains four labeled detail panels: FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The FACE close-up shows a neutral, stern expression, visible skin texture, and a scar near the eyebrow on the viewer's left.
The JACKET COLLAR detail shows black fabric with straps and metal buckles; the HANDS detail shows weathered, visibly soiled hands; the BOOTS detail shows worn black leather lace-up combat boots.

Lighting is low-key and moody: the hero panel uses cool blue-gray night tones with warm amber street and window lights, while the turnaround and detail panels use soft directional light against charcoal backgrounds.
Visible on-screen text reads HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

limitations: Small background signage or markings in the upper-right building area are not clearly legible.
